name: Global Warming
overview: Scripture teaches that God entrusted mankind with the responsibility to steward and care for the earth, as seen in His command to Adam to dress and keep the garden (Genesis 2:15). The natural order of seasons and climate changes is established by God and will continue while the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). However, the earth becomes defiled when its inhabitants transgress God's laws and break His covenant, resulting in consequences for the land (Isaiah 24:5; Leviticus 18:24; Leviticus 20:22). Despite upheaval in creation, believers need not fear because God remains sovereign over all (Psalms 46:2).
